from manim import *
import numpy as np


class MainScene(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = "#101827"
        title = Text("Coordinate system", font_size=38).to_edge(UP, buff=0.3)
        axes = Axes(
            x_range=[-3, 3, 1],
            y_range=[-1, 5, 1],
            x_length=7.2,
            y_length=4.8,
            axis_config={"color": GREY_B, "include_tip": True},
            tips=True,
        ).shift(LEFT * 1.9 + DOWN * 0.3)

        x_label = Text("x-axis", font_size=23).next_to(axes.x_axis.get_end(), DOWN, buff=0.18)
        y_label = Text("y-axis", font_size=23).next_to(axes.y_axis.get_end(), UP, buff=0.15)
        tick_labels = VGroup()
        for x in [-2, -1, 1, 2]:
            tick_labels.add(Text(str(x), font_size=19).next_to(axes.c2p(x, 0), DOWN, buff=0.14))
        for y in [1, 2, 3, 4]:
            tick_labels.add(Text(str(y), font_size=19).next_to(axes.c2p(0, y), LEFT, buff=0.14))

        origin_dot = Dot(axes.c2p(0, 0), radius=0.045, color=WHITE)
        origin_label = Text("origin (0, 0)", font_size=22).move_to(axes.c2p(-1.05, -0.85))
        origin_arrow = Arrow(
            origin_label.get_right() + UP * 0.08,
            axes.c2p(0, 0),
            buff=0.1,
            stroke_width=2,
            max_tip_length_to_length_ratio=0.18,
            color=GREY_B,
        )
        self.play(Write(title), Create(axes), run_time=1.1)
        self.play(
            FadeIn(tick_labels), FadeIn(x_label), FadeIn(y_label),
            FadeIn(origin_dot), FadeIn(origin_label), GrowArrow(origin_arrow),
            run_time=0.9,
        )

        equation = Text("y = x^2", font_size=34, color=YELLOW).move_to([4.25, 2.25, 0])
        rule = Text("Square x to find y", font_size=23).next_to(equation, DOWN, buff=0.25)
        direction = Text("Motion: x increases", font_size=23, color=GREY_B).next_to(rule, DOWN, buff=0.3)
        step = Text("Step 1 / 3", font_size=29, color=BLUE_B).move_to([4.25, 0.3, 0])
        calculation = Text("(-2)^2 = 4", font_size=28).move_to([4.25, -0.3, 0])
        coordinate = Text("(x, y) = (-2.00, 4.00)", font_size=23).move_to([4.25, -1.0, 0])

        tracker = ValueTracker(-2)
        point = Dot(axes.c2p(-2, 4), radius=0.085, color=RED_C)
        point.add_updater(lambda m: m.move_to(axes.c2p(tracker.get_value(), tracker.get_value() ** 2)))
        trace = TracedPath(point.get_center, stroke_color=YELLOW, stroke_width=5)
        trace.set_z_index(2)
        point.set_z_index(5)
        point_label = Text("moving point", font_size=23, color=RED_C)
        point_label.add_updater(lambda m: m.move_to(point.get_center() + UP * 0.7 + RIGHT * 0.55))
        point_arrow = always_redraw(lambda: Arrow(
            point.get_center() + UP * 0.52 + RIGHT * 0.48,
            point.get_center(), buff=0.12, stroke_width=2,
            color=RED_C, max_tip_length_to_length_ratio=0.24,
        ))

        def update_coordinate(m):
            x = tracker.get_value()
            if abs(x) < 0.005:
                x = 0.0
            m.become(Text(
                f"(x, y) = ({x:.2f}, {x*x:.2f})", font_size=23
            ).move_to([4.25, -1.0, 0]))

        self.play(FadeIn(equation), FadeIn(rule), FadeIn(direction), run_time=0.7)
        self.add(trace, point, point_arrow, point_label)
        self.play(FadeIn(step), FadeIn(calculation), FadeIn(coordinate), run_time=0.6)
        self.wait(0.6)
        coordinate.add_updater(update_coordinate)

        self.play(tracker.animate.set_value(0), run_time=3, rate_func=linear)
        self.play(
            Transform(step, Text("Step 2 / 3", font_size=29, color=BLUE_B).move_to(step)),
            Transform(calculation, Text("0^2 = 0", font_size=28).move_to(calculation)),
            run_time=0.45,
        )
        self.wait(0.65)
        self.play(tracker.animate.set_value(2), run_time=3, rate_func=linear)
        self.play(
            Transform(step, Text("Step 3 / 3", font_size=29, color=BLUE_B).move_to(step)),
            Transform(calculation, Text("2^2 = 4", font_size=28).move_to(calculation)),
            run_time=0.45,
        )
        coordinate.clear_updaters()
        conclusion = Text("Traced curve: parabola", font_size=25, color=YELLOW).move_to([0, -3.3, 0])
        interval = Text("Shown for -2 ≤ x ≤ 2", font_size=21, color=GREY_B).move_to([4.25, -1.65, 0])
        self.play(FadeIn(conclusion), FadeIn(interval), run_time=0.65)
        self.wait(1.2)
